description: Native QQ Music playlist and track downloader.
pre_install: $binary = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -Filter 'qmdr-*-windows-amd64.exe' -File | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -eq $binary) { throw 'Qmdr executable was not found.' }; Rename-Item -LiteralPath $binary.FullName -NewName 'qmdr.exe'
